activity_summary: Before church Mistress Ansell gave you the verdict she had prepared in the night. The girl should have minded her mother, and the mother the girl. The friar was a meddler, the nurse wanted whipping, and the old men were fools. She had something in her eye at the end, and that was all she would say of it. Verbeke asked whether the two houses were friends after. She said for the length of a speech. Alse asked if they were boys, even the one that dies. You told her he is fifteen, lodges in Aldermanbury, and ate two pies after. She will not go again. The loaf was not put to the notch.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Waited, answered the boy question, and left the notch alone.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Gave the verdict, stopped at the end, and refused a second time.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked the question she had held since four o'clock, and was answered.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Asked whether the houses were friends, and stayed with the house.

facets.activity: Heard Mistress Ansell's verdict before church

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: She should have minded her mother.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The torches smoked. I had something in mine eye at the end. That is all I shall say of the end.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: For the length of a speech.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I shall not go again. Once is knowledge. Twice is appetite.

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: Is it true they're boys? All of them? Even the one that dies?

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Even she. He's fifteen, and lodges in Aldermanbury, and ate two pies after.
